description: Newest-first drift. Anonymous: last 5 summaries. Subscriber for that origin: full history.

domain.description: Public hostname without a scheme. A scheme, port, path, and leading www. are stripped if present. After normalize: two or more DNS labels, each [a-z0-9] with optional interior hyphens (max 63 chars), total length at most 253. Empty input, literal IPs, and bare labels are rejected.

limit.description: Optional result cap. Anonymous callers always get the last 5 summaries. A subscriber for that origin: default 20, minimum 1, maximum 50. Only a number is forwarded; other types are ignored.

name: list_changes
